item.title: Waterfront Demolition
item.description: Bedford is seeing even more exciting development. Over the holiday break, two large domiciles, long since abandoned, were torn down near the docks.

item.title: Empress Amber I Crowned
item.description: On January 4th, Pavian citizenry from across all classes gathered to usher in a new era for the Empire, with the coronation of Pavia’s first Empress, Amber I of House Solberg.

item.title: New Year’s Gifts and Honors
item.description: On December 27th, Pavia’s nobles gathered in the newly-renovated Town Hall gardens for a Secret Santa ceremony organized by Mayor CedarValiant.

item.title: Unconstitutional?
item.description: On Monday morning, just half a day after the election results were announced, Prime Minister Gobblin presented his first official act at a press conference.

item.title: Left-Wing Party Turmoil Persists
item.description: After the AMP was founded shortly before the last election under the chairmanship of CedarValiant, it was merged into the LUL, which was founded on Monday, according to a joint press release this evening.

item.title: Gobblin Gobbles Prime Ministership
item.description: In what came as a shock result to some, the UPP received a nearly immediate win in the first round of voting with 14 votes, leading to a 15 vote win in the second round.

item.title: Prime Minister Resigns
item.description: In a surprising turn of events, Cissonius has today announced his immediate resignation from the post of Prime Minister, a development that has surprised many political pundits and the reasoning is nothing short of curious.

item.title: Debris Crisis Continues On
item.description: For another week in a row, the global debris crisis has also hit Pavia’s economy and consumers, despite high demand there are hardly any suppliers, why is that?

item.title: PM Betrayal Plunges Country Into Chaos
item.description: After the cabinet under Prime Minister Cissonius launched tax and immigration reforms at the beginning of the week, he has now cancelled the governing coalition with Renew.

item.title: Mayor Ahri Announces Public Health Initiative
item.description: Away from the trench warfare of national politics, the newly elected mayor of Pavia, Ahrimanne, has launched a city-wide initiative to combat ‘hunger, malnutrition and widespread vitamin deficiencies’.

item.title: Sixteen Hospitalised In Latest Street Unrests
item.description: Sixteen Pavians, of whom five currently in critical condition, were admitted to the Pavian Hospital of the Well-Heeled last night as a result of a violent confrontation among widespread unrest in the city.

item.title: How To Behave During A Riot
item.description: Due to the ongoing protests and public outbreaks of violence, caution is advised on the streets and squares of Pavia.

item.title: Pudding Lane Violence Continues

item.description: The new Vetranian Botanical Gardens have suffered a massive blow: a massive infestation of squirrels.

item.description: Pavia is facing a severe floating exchange crisis affecting its key markets.

item.title: Ahrimanne Stomps CedarValiant in Pre-Election debate
item.description: In a heated debate that captured the attention of Pavia’s residents, mayoral candidates Ahrimanne and CedarValiant passionately presented their visions for the city’s future.

item.title: Ahri Sets Sights on Triumph Amid Cedar’s Growing Doubts
item.description: While the first mayoral election for the city of Pavia is still ongoing, Pavia Daily sought insights from the candidates on their chances and the impact of the recent debate.
